issues: anatomy_structure: stage 3 is not a recognisable coil of nucleosomes: a small DNA ring sits on top of an irregular pile of large teal beads with a few orange nucleosomes poking out
palette: stage 3 adds large solid teal beads that do not match the nucleosome look of stage 2, so the stages do not read as one thing getting more packed
repeated_elements: the first nucleosome's histone core is red-orange and larger-looking while the other three are pale yellow-orange; all four must be drawn identically
palette: two different oranges (red-orange and yellow-orange) are used, the brief allows one orange accent
